title: CraftEgon CCS Regulatory and Statutory Sources Registry Schema
description: JSON Schema enforcing structural validity, authority metadata, and citation rules for statutory sources.

source_id.description: Stable unique identifier for the source (e.g. SRC-MCA-001).

source_title.description: Formal title of the statute, portal, or internal record.

issuing_authority.description: Government ministry, statutory regulator, or governing authority.

official_url.description: Official portal URL or verified repository link.

publication_date.description: Official enactment, gazette, or record publication date (YYYY-MM-DD).

accessed_date.description: Date when the official source was accessed or inspected (YYYY-MM-DD).

next_review_at.description: Scheduled date for next periodic review (YYYY-MM-DD).

access_restrictions_notes.description: Permitted access modes, API availability, or scraping prohibitions.
